lines.en: I float in the air, wobbling.
My fleshy wings beat slowly.
I drift toward you.
My body is like an eyeball.
I spiral inward toward you.
I fly low for a stretch.
One beat of my wings lifts me higher.
I leave a trail of slime.
My tendrils sway beneath me.
I drift forward in little hops.
I pass through the grass.
I angle toward your flank.
I stop, then move again.
My drifting path is never straight.
My shadow shivers along the ground.
I edge a little closer to you.
I hang, rising and falling slowly.

lines.zh: 我不需要眨眼，也不用睡。
lines.en: I never blink, and I never sleep.
Something is moving in the dark.
I make a soft wet sound.
My wings are half folded.
I have not stirred yet.
I tilt and steady.
There is faint breathing over there.
My tendrils curl.
My master has not pointed me anywhere yet.
I wait for the dark to thicken.
My body starts to roil again.
I aim my whole eye at you.

lines.zh: 我这一只眼比你的头还大。
lines.en: My one eye is bigger than your head.
You are being watched.
I bring my eye up to yours.
I can sense you.
My wings spread slowly.
You did not flinch.
I am in your breathing.
You should step back.
My wings have begun to tremble.
I lurch sideways in the air.
My glow dims.

lines.zh: 我被撞得往后滑了一段。
lines.en: I slide back a short way from the blow.
Slime drips.
I make a thin sound.

lines.zh: 左边那片翼膜塌了下去。
lines.en: The membrane on my left side has caved in.

lines.zh: 我打了个旋才找回平衡。
lines.en: I spin once before I find my balance.
I am unsteady.
I have not scattered.
I have learned the smell of your sweat.
Feeding me is a pointless business.
Put it down.
I do not have a single tooth.
I need something else.
I drift aside.
This has no smell.
Dead things like that do not draw me.
Why look at it?
I drift around that thing and away.
Your hand does not fool me.
You bump me and I drift away.

lines.zh: 撞上我就像撞一团湿布。
lines.en: Hitting me is like hitting wet cloth.
Slime smears on you.
I float back.
I press briefly against your shoulder.
My cold seeps into your skin.
I bounce off half a block.
We collide, and only slime makes a sound.
My wing beats by your ear.
I retreat upward.
There are others in the dark.
They are all waiting for him.

lines.zh: 我们几只贴成一团湿肉。
lines.en: We press into one wet mass.
We talk by trembling our wing membranes.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛和它们的眼睛一起亮。
lines.en: My eye lights with theirs.
We circle low.
We fly slowly.
None comes near another.
We wait to be called.
The dark is quiet again.
My tendrils coil around it.
I hold it in the air.
It is as light as a scrap of dried skin.
It slips off me.
I scoop it up again.
I do not know what it is for.

lines.zh: 我把它轻轻推到你鞋尖。
lines.en: I nudge it to the tip of your boot.
I do not want it.
This thing is hard enough to hurt my tendrils.
It sinks into my body.

lines.zh: 你在暗处我照样看得见。
lines.en: I see you plainly, even in the dark.

lines.zh: 眼球里有什么东西醒了。
lines.en: Something has woken inside my eye.
I fold my wings and dive at you.
My wings spread wide.
You cannot run.
I am accelerating.
This is a short dash.
I come in low.
This eye has room only for you.
Turn your head and you will see me.

lines.zh: 往上看，我就在你鼻尖上。
lines.en: Look up. I am right at your nose.
Wherever you hide, I will follow.
That wet sound is me closing in.
I am moving.
I circle along the shape of you.
My shadow sweeps across you.
I hear your steps losing their nerve.
I hang above the back of your neck.
I drop altitude.
The wall is already at your back.

lines.zh: 我又一次压低了翅膀冲。
lines.en: Once more I sweep in low on my wings.
You twist aside.
My wing scrapes you.
I have not folded my wings once.
My shadow falls over your head.
You finally look up for me.
I am almost on you.
This ground is ours.
I slam my whole body into you.
My tendril lashes you.
I press my body onto you.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀边缘划开你的皮。
lines.en: My wing edge opens your skin.
You bat me away.
I press down over your face.
My eye is very close.
Your skin prickles.
The second blow lands on your chest.
I drive you backwards.
An eye surfaces in the dark.

lines.zh: 我从黏液的池子里升起。
lines.en: I rise from the pool of slime.
My wings open for the first time.
The air here turns damp.
I float and look around.
I wait for whoever woke me.
My tendrils hang down.
My eye turns slowly toward you.
I make a wet, sliding sound.
I rise to your eye level.

lines.zh: 火燎到我的翅膀，它卷了起来。
lines.en: Fire catches my wing and it curls.
I hit the ground and spread into a puddle.
Water closes around me.
The blast scatters half of me.

lines.zh: 箭从我软肉里穿了出去。
lines.en: The arrow passed straight through my soft flesh.
Spell-light burns away a piece of wing.
I grow lighter and lighter.

lines.zh: 雷光把黑暗照白，我缩紧。
lines.en: Lightning whitens the dark and I clench tight.
The void draws me in slowly.
